anchors.description: Black whiteboard marker/eraser with red end lying in the whiteboard accessory tray; long-axis distance between the visible left and right end corners.
anchors.visible_evidence: Whiteboard tray at lower left holds a black pen-like accessory with a red end; the two end corners of the object are visible against the white tray.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact product/model unknown; a standard whiteboard marker (~0.135 m) and a small whiteboard eraser (~0.13 m) have similar long-axis length.

anchors.description: Square single-rocker light-switch faceplate on the right wall; vertical side length of the outer plate between its top and bottom edges.
anchors.visible_evidence: White square switch plate with a large central rocker mounted on the right-hand wall; the outer plate bounds form a closed square.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: European 55-mm-system single covers are about 81x81 mm, but smaller ~55x55 mm Swiss covers also exist; the interval covers both standards, and the low-contrast plate edges add a few mm of uncertainty.
